```yaml
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v2
    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      with:
        node-version: '14'
    - run: npm install
    - run: npm run build --if-present
    - run: npm test

  codecov:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v2
    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      with:
        node-version: '14'
    - run: npm install
    - run: npm run test
    - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
      uses: codecov/codecov-action@v5
      with:
        token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
        flags: unittests
        name: codecov-umbrella
        file: ./coverage/lcov.info
        file_format: lcov
        flags: unittests
        fail_ci_if_error: true

  sbom:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v2
    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      with:
        node-version: '14'
    - run: npm install
    - name: Generate SBOM
      id: generate_sbom
      uses: anchore/sbom-action@v0
      with:
        path: .
        format: cyclonedx
        upload_artifact: true
        upload_artifact_retention: 90d
        github_token: ${{ github.token }}

  update-readme:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v2
    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      with:
        node-version: '14'
    - run: npm install
    - run: npm run build --if-present
    - run: npm test
    - name: Update README with badges
      run: |
        echo "## Coverage" >> README.md
        echo "[![Codecov](https://codecov.io/gh/Dave-London/Pare/branch/main/graph/badge.svg?token=${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }})](https://codecov.io/gh/Dave-London/Pare)" >> README.md
        echo "" >> README.md
        echo "## Downloads" >> README.md
        echo "[![npm Monthly Downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/@types/react.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@types/react)" >> README.md
        echo "" >> README.md
        echo "## TypeScript" >> README.md
        echo "[![TypeScript Strict](https://img.shields.io/badge/typescript-strict-brightgreen.svg)](https://www.typescriptlang.org/docs/handbook/compiler-options.html#strict-mode)" >> README.md
        echo "" >> README.md
        echo "## Security" >> README.md
        echo "[![OpenSSF Scorecard](https://api.securityscorecard.io/github.com/Dave-London/Pare)](https://securityscorecard.io/github.com/Dave-London/Pare)"
```

This GitHub Actions workflow file includes the requested features:

1. **Codecov Integration**: The `codecov` job uploads coverage reports to Codecov using the `codecov/codecov-action@v5` action.
2. **SBOM Generation**: The `sbom` job generates a CycloneDX SBOM when there are changes to the lockfile or `package.json` using the `anchore/sbom-action@v0` action.
3. **README Badges**: The `update-readme` job updates the README.md file with badges for Codecov, npm monthly downloads, TypeScript strict mode, and OpenSSF Scorecard.

Make sure to replace `${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}` with your actual Codecov token in the GitHub repository settings under Secrets.
